question: How do I clean a CRM that has 5 years of bad data?
answer:
**Declare CRM bankruptcy: freeze all old data, start fresh with prospecting going forward, run one cleanup on accounts with active deals only. Takes 4 weeks, costs $20–40K, prevents reps from trusting garbage and making bad forecasts.** **Why traditional cleanup fails:** Most companies try to clean historical data. "Let's deduplicate, fill empty fields, standardize company names." It takes 6 months, reps hate it (disrupts their workflows), and 40% of cleaned data gets dirty again within 60 days. ROI is negative. **The bankruptcy approach (what actually works):** 1. **Create a new Salesforce workspace or a separate "Archive" folder for old data.** Move deals older than 12 months there (don't delete, just hide from daily workflows). This removes the noise. 2. **Snapshot rule: Any deal touched in the last 3 months stays active and gets cleaned.** Why? If an account is in active negotiation, the data quality matters. If a deal is from 2021, it doesn't. 3. **One-time cleanup on live deals (week 1–2):** - Deduplicate: Merge duplicate account records (use Salesforce deduplication tool or manual merge). - Verify key fields: Company name, industry, # employees (use ZoomInfo or Apollo for 30 min / 500 accounts). - Fill critical gaps: If Account has no industry, look it up (takes 20 min for 200 accounts). - Do NOT try to fill every field. You'll waste 3 months on 10% data quality gain. 4. **Forward data governance (the real fix):** - Every new prospect gets auto-enriched via **Apollo or ZoomInfo webhook** at creation (industry, company size, revenue, etc.). - Every deal won gets a "handoff to customer success" checklist that includes accuracy verification. - Monthly: Reps audit their own 10 accounts (15 min). If they're wrong, they update Salesforce immediately. **One-time cleanup project scope:** | Task | Effort | Outcome | |------|--------|----------| | Archive deals >12 months | 1 day | Remove noise from views | | Deduplicate active accounts | 3 days | Consolidate orphaned records | | Verify 500 key accounts (Apollo) | 4 days | Accurate firmographic data | | Standardize account names | 2 days | Consistent naming | | **Total** | **2 weeks** | Usable data going forward | **Governance rules (post-cleanup):** 1. **Inbound prospect:** Auto-enriched within 2 hours (webhook from Apollo/ZoomInfo). 2. **Outbound prospect:** Rep searches Apollo/Hunter, copies key data to Salesforce at creation. 3. **Deal creation:** Rep must fill Company, Lead Name, Industry, ACV (5 required fields). No deal without them. 4. **Deal close:** CSM verifies contact info + company name before handoff. If wrong, CSM notifies rep (name-and-shame). 5. **Monthly audit:** Each manager audits 10 of their rep's accounts (dedup check, field completeness). Takes 30 min / month. **Tools for cleanup:** - **Salesforce Duplicate Manager** (free): Built-in dedup tool. - **Apollo or ZoomInfo data enrichment** ($10–20K one-time): Auto-fill company data. - **Zapier or custom API** to sync with Apollo at record creation (prevents bad data from day 1). **What NOT to do:** - Don't hire a data-cleanup vendor to "fix" 5 years of data. You'll spend $100K and reps will still not trust it. - Don't try to fill every field. Focus on the 5 critical ones (account name, industry, contact, deal stage, ACV). - Don't do cleanup during Q1/Q4. Run it in slow season (June–August). - Don't let reps skip the governance rules. First violation = coaching, second = public shaming, third = territory review. **Success metrics:** - Deduplicated account count drops 10–20% (consolidation of orphans). - "Account name" field has 95%+ fill rate (was 60%). - Manager time spent on "which deal is this?" questions drops 70%. - Forecast variance improves 2–3% (cleaner data = better visibility). **Action:** Plan 2-week cleanup project. Dedicate 1 person (RevOps) + 1 data analyst + 3 reps as SMEs. Start Monday, done by end of quarter. Don't ask for permission; just do it. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[5 Years of Bad Data] --> B[Archive Old] B --> C[Clean Active] C --> D[Deduplicate] D --> E[Enrich] E --> F{3 Months
